payload.evidence_summary: Mission 1 gate (trigger mission1-gate:next_assignment_infeasible:belief-157, input_revision 157, belief revision 4) reports the plan's next fixed-view leg — assignment-2, candidate-90d7281a38aa1d3bd0a13e1f at (-920,-874), arrival deadline 243.5s — as infeasible. This is a concrete feasibility break in the remainder of the route, not a repeated ledger or stale source; all sources are healthy and fresh. Current assignment-1 (plan rev 3, (-1064,-842), deadline 198.5s) remains in progress with the drone ~77m out in navigate phase. An infeasible next leg materially invalidates the route, so a fresh planner verification is warranted to recompute reachability/utility and select a feasible replacement for the downstream leg. The prior revision-003 plan stays authoritative until the replacement passes MiniZinc and Statechart validation; no physical cancellation occurs here.
